### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal: cheese pizza, dressed romaine salad with croutons and shaved cheese, broccoli, and what appears to be cooked chicken.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Allowing for its square shape, I use an **equivalent circular diameter of 28 cm**:
Area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ **615 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, area, volume, weight, and energy
The salad appears coated with creamy dressing. Pizza cheese and tomato sauce are included in the pizza estimate.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Romaine lettuce | 32% | 197 × 2.5 = 493 ml | 0.15 | 74 | 20 | 15 |
| Cheese pizza | 23% | 141 × 1.0 = 141 ml | 0.95 | 134 | 270 | 362 |
| Cooked broccoli | 9% | 55 × 2.0 = 110 ml | 0.60 | 66 | 35 | 23 |
| Cooked chicken pieces | 10% | 62 × 1.3 = 81 ml | 0.95 | 77 | 180 | 139 |
| Croutons | 3% | 18 × 1.5 = 27 ml | 0.40 | 11 | 400 | 44 |
| Shaved cheese | 2% | 12 × 0.25 = 3 ml | 1.0 | 3 | 400 | 12 |
| Creamy salad dressing | Overlay* | 100 × 0.2 = 20 ml | 1.0 | 20 | 450 | 90 |

*Dressing coats part of the salad, so it adds no separate footprint. The other allocations total **79% coverage**, consistent with the visible empty plate. Croutons use a bread-like bulk density; all volumes above are gross volumes with only one density conversion.*

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **385 g and approximately 685 kcal**. This is plausible for one pizza slice, a fairly large but light salad, and small portions of chicken and broccoli. Dressing quantity and pizza thickness are the main uncertainties.
